series.name: WIT 50-100K Storage/Hybrid Inverter (three-phase C&I)
series.notes: Three-phase commercial/industrial storage-hybrid unit, GR-UM-299-A-02. Manual splits codes into Table 9.1 Warning (200-609, output derating) and Table 9.2 Error (200-606, damage or misconfiguration). Digit meanings here match the WIT manual only - several same-digit codes read differently on the TL3 string bodies (e.g. WIT Error 200 = AFCI Fault, WIT Error 303 = NE Abnormal, WIT Error 400 = DCI bias abnormal). Common in PK commercial installs.

meaning.en: An arc fault has been detected on a PV string and the AFCI has interrupted it.
meaning.ur: PV string par arc fault detect hua aur AFCI ne use interrupt kar diya.

causes.en: Arcing at a PV connector, module lead or DC cable
causes.ur: PV connector, module lead ya DC cable par arcing

causes.en: Loose or burnt DC terminal creating an intermittent arc
causes.ur: Loose ya burnt DC terminal se intermittent arc banta hai

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and wait before opening the wiring box.
solutions.ur: DC switch band karein aur wiring box kholne se pehle wait karein.

solutions.en: After shutdown, check the connection of the PV string at every DC terminal.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad har DC terminal par PV string ka connection check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

meaning.en: An excessively high leakage current has been detected and the inverter has stopped.
meaning.ur: Bohat zyada leakage current detect hua aur inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Insulation breakdown in PV wiring or a wet connector
causes.ur: PV wiring mein insulation failure ya geela connector

causes.en: Damaged SPD or filter capacitor leaking to earth
causes.ur: Damaged SPD ya filter capacitor ka earth par leakage

solutions.en: Isolate PV and AC, then measure array insulation resistance with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: PV aur AC isolate karke megohmmeter se array ka insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect strings one by one to isolate the leaking string.
solutions.ur: Strings ko ek-ek karke disconnect karke leaking string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

meaning.en: DC input voltage has exceeded the upper threshold the inverter will accept.
meaning.ur: DC input voltage inverter ki maani jane wali upper threshold se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: String Voc above the inverter maximum in cold conditions
causes.ur: Thande mausam mein string ka Voc inverter maximum se upar

causes.en: Too many modules per string for this model
causes.ur: Is model ke liye string mein modules zyada hain

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch immediately and measure the DC voltage.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran disconnect karke DC voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If the DC input voltage is within the permissible range and the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar DC input voltage permissible range mein hai aur message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The PV panels have low insulation resistance to earth. Growatt's manual carries an explicit DANGER not to touch the equipment in this state.
meaning.ur: PV panels ka earth ke taraf insulation resistance kam hai. Growatt ke manual mein is state mein equipment ko haath na lagane ki saaf DAGER warning hai.

causes.en: Damaged module backsheet or water in the junction box
causes.ur: Damaged module backsheet ya junction box mein paani

causes.en: Cable chafe against the mounting structure
causes.ur: Mounting structure ke sath cable ka rub jana

solutions.en: Do not touch the unit. Isolate AC and PV first, always.
solutions.ur: Unit ko haath na lagayein. Pehle AC aur PV isolate karein, hamesha.

solutions.en: After shutdown, check if the PV panels are properly grounded.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke PV panels theek se grounded hain.

solutions.en: Use a megohmmeter to find the string with low insulation, then replace the damaged component.
solutions.ur: Megohmmeter se dhoondein kaun si string ki insulation kam hai, phir damaged component badlein.

title.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se bahar hai

meaning.en: Grid voltage is outside the range the inverter is allowed to connect to.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage us range se bahar hai jis mein inverter connect ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage sag or surge from a large load step
causes.ur: Bade load step se grid voltage ka sag ya surge

causes.en: Transformer tap position wrong for the local supply
causes.ur: Transformer ka tap position local supply ke liye ghalat

solutions.en: Check the grid voltage with a true-RMS meter at the AC terminals.
solutions.ur: AC terminals par true-RMS meter se grid voltage check karein.

solutions.en: If the grid voltage is within the permissible range and the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar grid voltage permissible range mein hai aur message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

title.en: No AC / utility grid power failure
title.ur: AC nahi hai / utility grid power failure

meaning.en: No utility grid is present, so the inverter has gone to off-grid or standby.
meaning.ur: Utility grid mojood nahi, is liye inverter off-grid ya standby par chala gaya.

causes.en: Upstream grid breaker or fuse open
causes.ur: Upstream grid breaker ya fuse open hai

causes.en: AC wiring broken at the inverter terminals
causes.ur: Inverter terminals par AC wiring tooti hui hai

solutions.en: After shutdown, check the AC wiring at the inverter terminals.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad inverter terminals par AC wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Verify grid voltage is actually reaching the AC terminal with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se confirm karein ke grid voltage AC terminal tak pohanch raha hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Close the upstream breaker once wiring is confirmed sound, then restart.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek confirm hone ke baad upstream breaker band karke restart karein.

title.ur: NE abnormal (N aur PE ka voltage abnormal)

meaning.en: The voltage difference between the N line and the PE cable is abnormal.
meaning.ur: N line aur PE cable ke darmiyan voltage difference abnormal hai.

causes.en: PE conductor not reliably connected between inverter and earth
causes.ur: Inverter aur earth ke darmiyan PE conductor mazboot se nahi lagi

causes.en: N and PE swapped at the AC terminal
causes.ur: AC terminal par N aur PE swap ho gaye hain

solutions.en: After shutdown, check that the ground cable is reliably connected.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke ground cable mazboot se lagi hai.

solutions.en: Measure N-to-PE voltage; it should be near 0 V on a healthy system.
solutions.ur: N se PE voltage measure karein; theek system mein ye qareeb 0 V hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Re-torque the PE lug and re-check; if it persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: PE lug dobara torque karke dobara check karein; phir bhi rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Grid frequency is out of range, or the rate of change of frequency is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency range se bahar hai, ya frequency badalne ki rate abnormal hai.

causes.en: Generator or weak supply with a fast frequency swing
causes.ur: Generator ya kamzor supply jismein frequency tez badal rahi ho

causes.en: Grid-code ROCOF limit set too tight for a weak local grid
causes.ur: Grid-code ROCOF limit kamzor local grid ke liye bohat sakht set hai

solutions.en: Check the grid frequency and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Grid frequency check karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: If the frequency is normal, log the times it happens to see if it matches load switching.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency normal hai to hone ke waqt note karein taake pata chale load switching se match karta hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The anti-export / zero-export limit function has tripped into its fail-safe state.
meaning.ur: Anti-export / zero-export limit function apne fail-safe state mein chala gaya hai.

causes.en: CT and meter wiring wrong, or meter not communicating
causes.ur: CT aur meter wiring ghalat, ya meter communicate nahi kar raha

causes.en: Export limit percentage set too low for the site
causes.ur: Site ke liye export limit percentage bohat kam set hai

solutions.en: After shutdown, check the connection of the CT and the meter at both ends.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad CT aur meter ke connection ko dono taraf check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the CT arrow points toward the load and the CT ratio matches the meter setting.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke CT ka arrow load ki taraf hai aur CT ratio meter setting se match karta hai.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The internal relay or its control has failed to operate or report back correctly.
meaning.ur: Internal relay ya uska control operate ya report theek se nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Relay coil or contacts burnt, often after an arc trip
causes.ur: Relay coil ya contacts burnt, aksar arc trip ke baad

causes.en: Relay driver on the control board failed
causes.ur: Control board par relay driver fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then listen for the relay click on start attempt.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke start karte waqt relay ki click check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; a single click and a cleared code means an interlock event, not a failed relay.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; sirf ek click aur code clear ho jaye to interlock event hai, relay kharab nahi.

solutions.en: If the relay never operates, the relay/board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar relay kabhi operate na ho to relay/board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

meaning.en: The gate drive to the power IGBT module has failed.
meaning.ur: Power IGBT module ka gate drive fail ho gaya.

causes.en: IGBT module or its gate drive PCB has failed
causes.ur: IGBT module ya uska gate drive PCB fail hai

causes.en: Over-voltage event that destroyed the module
causes.ur: Over-voltage event jisne module kharab kar diya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely and wait for the bus to discharge before opening.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery poori tarah isolate karke bus discharge hone tak wait karein.

solutions.en: Restart once; do not power-cycle repeatedly on an IGBT fault.
solutions.ur: Ek baar restart karein; IGBT fault par baar baar on/off na karein.

solutions.en: Contact Growatt support for board replacement under warranty.
solutions.ur: Warranty ke teht board badalwane ke liye Growatt support se rabta karein.

meaning.en: The control board cannot read or write its settings memory.
meaning.ur: Control board apni settings memory parh ya likh nahi sakta.

causes.en: EEPROM chip or I2C solder joint failure on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par EEPROM chip ya I2C solder joint fail

causes.en: Power interruption during a settings write
causes.ur: Settings write ke dauran power chala jana

solutions.en: Isolate all energy sources, wait 5 minutes, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Tamam energy sources isolate karke 5 minute wait karein, phir inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Note whether the error only appears in the morning - that points to a marginal chip.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke error sirf subah aata hai ya nahi - ye marginal chip ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: If the fault is sustained, the control board must be replaced - claim Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar fault barqarar rahe to control board badalna parega - Growatt support se claim karein.

aliases: DSP and COM firmware version mismatch

title.en: DSP and COM firmware version mismatch
title.ur: DSP aur COM firmware version mismatch hai

meaning.en: The DSP firmware and the communication board firmware versions do not match.
meaning.ur: DSP firmware aur communication board firmware versions match nahi karte.

causes.en: One board updated or replaced without the other
causes.ur: Ek board update ya replace hua aur doosra nahi hua

causes.en: Firmware upload interrupted part way
causes.ur: Firmware upload beech mein ruk gaya

solutions.en: Read and record both firmware versions before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch badalne se pehle dono firmware versions padh kar note karein.

solutions.en: Update both boards to a matched firmware pair from the Growatt download centre.
solutions.ur: Dono boards ko Growatt download centre se matched firmware pair par update karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle and confirm the version pair matches on the display or app.
solutions.ur: Power-cycle karke display ya app par confirm karein ke version pair match karta hai.

title.en: BMS failed to communicate with inverter
title.ur: BMS inverter se communicate nahi kar paya

meaning.en: The battery management system and the inverter cannot talk over RS485/CAN.
meaning.ur: Battery management system aur inverter RS485/CAN par baat nahi kar pa rahe.

causes.en: RS485 cable between inverter and battery loose, reversed or cut
causes.ur: Inverter aur battery ke darmiyan RS485 cable loose, reversed ya cut

causes.en: Battery in sleep mode, so it is not answering the bus
causes.ur: Battery sleep mode mein hai, is liye bus ka jawab nahi de rahi

solutions.en: Check the connection of the RS485 cable between the inverter and the battery at both ends.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur battery ke darmiyan RS485 cable ka connection dono taraf check karein.

solutions.en: Check if the battery is in sleep mode; wake it and confirm it answers before restarting.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery sleep mode mein hai ya nahi; use jaagayein aur jawab dene ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery type / BMS protocol setting matches the installed battery.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke battery type / BMS protocol setting installed battery se match karti hai.

title.ur: Battery voltage upper threshold se upar hai

meaning.en: Battery voltage has risen above the safe upper threshold, so charging is stopped.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage safe upper threshold se upar chala gaya, is liye charging band kar di gayi.

causes.en: Battery actually overcharged because the BMS has not opened
causes.ur: Battery asal mein overcharge ho gayi kyunke BMS ne open nahi kiya

causes.en: Battery voltage sense circuit reading high on a healthy pack
causes.ur: Theek battery par voltage sense circuit high reading de raha hai

solutions.en: Check the battery voltage with a multimeter at the battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery terminals par battery voltage check karein.

solutions.en: If it is within the permissible range, restart the inverter; if not, replace the battery.
solutions.ur: Agar permissible range mein hai to inverter restart karein; agar nahi to battery badal dein.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

title.en: Off-grid output short / off-grid bus voltage low
title.ur: Off-grid output short / off-grid bus voltage kam hai

meaning.en: On the EPS / off-grid port either a short circuit or an abnormally low bus voltage has been detected.
meaning.ur: EPS / off-grid port par ya short circuit ya abnormal kam bus voltage detect hua.

causes.en: Load connected to the EPS output has shorted
causes.ur: EPS output se jura load short ho gaya

causes.en: Battery voltage too low or a weak battery bank
causes.ur: Battery voltage bohat kam ya battery bank kamzor

solutions.en: Isolate the EPS output, then check for a short with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: EPS output isolate karke multimeter se short check karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the battery is working properly or has suffered capacity loss.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery theek chal rahi hai ya uski capacity gir gayi hai.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

title.ur: Balanced circuit self-test fail ho gaya

meaning.en: The internal balanced-circuit self-test did not pass, so the inverter will not run.
meaning.ur: Internal balanced-circuit self-test pass nahi hua, is liye inverter nahi chalega.

causes.en: Current sensing hardware out of tolerance on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par current sensing hardware tolerance se bahar

causes.en: Sampling reference or the redundant sampling channel has drifted
causes.ur: Sampling reference ya redundant sampling channel bekar chala hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and let the self-test run again.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke self-test dobara chalne dein.

solutions.en: If repeatable, isolate the unit and have Growatt check the current sensing board.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to unit isolate karke Growatt se current sensing board check karwayein.

meaning.en: The inverter reports a fan problem and will derate rather than stop.
meaning.ur: Inverter fan ki masla report karta hai aur band hone ke bajaye power kam kar deta hai.

causes.en: Fan connector not seated after service or transport
causes.ur: Service ya transport ke baad fan connector baitha nahi hua

causes.en: Fan bearing failed or blades blocked by dust
causes.ur: Fan bearing fail ya blades dhool se block

solutions.en: After shutdown, check if the fan is properly connected.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke fan theek se laga hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Reseat the fan connector and confirm the fan spins freely by hand.
solutions.ur: Fan connector dobara baithayein aur haath se confirm karein ke fan azaad ghoomta hai.

solutions.en: Clean or replace the fan if it is noisy or seized.
solutions.ur: Fan shor karta ho ya jam ho to use saaf karein ya badal dein.

meaning.en: The voltage difference between neutral and PE is outside its permitted band, so output is derated.
meaning.ur: Neutral aur PE ke darmiyan voltage difference permitted band se bahar hai, is liye output derate ho gaya.

causes.en: PE cable not reliably connected after shutdown
causes.ur: PE cable shutdown ke baad mazboot se nahi lagi

causes.en: Neutral-to-earth rise in the distribution board
causes.ur: Distribution board par neutral se earth tak voltage barh gaya

solutions.en: After shutdown, check that the PE cable is reliably connected.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke PE cable mazboot se lagi hai.

solutions.en: Measure N-to-PE at the inverter and at the board to find where the rise is.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur board dono par N se PE voltage measure karke dekhein voltage kahan barh raha hai.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.

title.ur: DC input voltage threshold se upar (warning 209)

meaning.en: PV DC input voltage is above the set upper threshold; output is limited until it falls.
meaning.ur: PV DC input voltage set upper threshold se upar hai; girne tak output limited rahega.

causes.en: String Voc high because of cold weather
causes.ur: Thande mausam ki wajah se string ka Voc zyada hai

causes.en: Upper DC voltage threshold set too low for the string
causes.ur: Upper DC voltage threshold string ke liye bohat kam set hai

solutions.en: Turn off the DC switch immediately and check the DC voltage.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran band karke DC voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the string Voc and compare it with the module datasheet at the coldest expected temperature.
solutions.ur: String ka Voc measure karke sab se thande expected temperature par module datasheet se compare karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is normal and the message persists, contact Growatt support.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage normal hai aur message bacha rahe to Growatt support se rabta karein.
